title: ProtvistaViewerConfig
description: Declarative configuration for a ProtVista viewer instance (v1). Source-of-truth JSON Schema, authored in lockstep with src/schema/types.ts.

version.description: Schema protocol version. Optional — defaults to "1.0" when omitted.

extends.description: One or more base configs to merge under this one. Each entry is a URL, a file path, or a registered preset name resolved via an embedder-supplied resolver.

accession.description: Primary accession (e.g. "P05067"). Used to interpolate {accession} placeholders. The element's accession attribute takes precedence. Required unless sequence is set; never both.

sequence.description: Show your own protein instead of a UniProt entry: raw residues, inline FASTA (a YAML `|` block), or a path/URL to a one-record FASTA file (resolved against the page). Mutually exclusive with accession, including the element's accession attribute. Tracks that need UniProt data ({accession} URLs, AlphaFold/AlphaMissense kinds, {accession} label links) are rejected.

sources.description: Map of named URL templates. Tracks reference these by key. Four keys also override the viewer's own requests, and keep their defaults when unset: sequenceEntry, structureUniprot, structureAlphafold and structureBeacons.

sequenceEntry.description: The entry the viewer reads the protein sequence from, which must answer with UniProt Proteins API JSON. Default: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/proteins/api/proteins/{accession}

structureUniprot.description: The UniProtKB entry the 3D structure panel reads PDB cross-references from. Default: https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{accession}

structureAlphafold.description: The AlphaFold DB predictions the 3D structure panel lists. Default: https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{accession}?include_complexes=true

structureBeacons.description: The 3D-Beacons summary the 3D structure panel lists models from. Default: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pdbe/pdbe-kb/3dbeacons/api/uniprot/summary/{accession}.json?exclude_provider=pdbe

variables.description: Baseline values for {token} template variables in data URLs (sources values and descriptor url:). Merged with the host element's data-* attributes and its accession attribute; precedence, lowest first: variables < data-* < accession. Token names match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]* and are case-sensitive; data-dataset-id supplies {datasetId}. Every token a data URL uses must resolve against one of the three sources.

strict.description: Promote every non-fatal warning (empty sequence, per-track fetch failure, setTrackData misuse) to a mount-level failure shown in the viewer's error panel. Default false.

showWarnings.description: Author mode: list every warning on the track or viewer it concerns, with the same text as the console and the protvista-error event, and expand error badges and the error panel into that detail. Equivalent to the element's show-warnings attribute; either turns it on. Default false.

rows.description: Ordered list of rows: each is either a group of tracks (has `tracks`) or a standalone track (has `data`, no `tracks`). Mixed freely; declaration order preserved.

TopLevelEntry.description: A group of tracks (has `tracks`) or a standalone track (has `data`, no `tracks`).

ConfigDefaults.description: Viewer-wide defaults inherited by every group/track.

ThemeConfig.description: Viewer-wide chrome colours, applied as --protvista-* custom properties on the host. A no-code way to recolour the viewer from the config (see docs/theming.md for the underlying tokens).

labelColor.description: One-colour tint for the row-label side panel: group labels get the colour itself, track labels a light tint of it — preserving the group-vs-track hierarchy. Label text, caret and hover state are derived to stay legible on it.

groupLabelColor.description: Exact background of collapsible group labels; overrides what labelColor would set.

trackLabelColor.description: Exact background of individual track labels; overrides the tint derived from labelColor.

accentColor.description: Primary accent — focus rings and the datatable active-row marker.

label.description: Human-readable label. A Markdoc inline source string — Markdown (emphasis, code, links) plus the `{% help slug="…" %}…{% /help %}` tag; `{accession}` is interpolated before rendering. Block-level markup is not supported. Falls back to a title-cased form of `id` if omitted.

description.description: Short plain-text description shown as a native tooltip (HTML `title` attribute) when hovering the group label. No Markdown or HTML interpretation.

hidden.description: Ship this row hidden. The row is absent from the render but is listed as a stub in customize mode so a user can reveal it. This is the same field the show/hide control writes, so an author's choice and a user's are the same state and getConfig() exports whichever is current. Defaults to false.

label.description: Human-readable label. A Markdoc inline source string — Markdown (emphasis, code, links) plus the `{% help slug="…" %}…{% /help %}` tag; `{accession}` is interpolated before rendering. Block-level markup is not supported. Falls back to a title-cased form of `id` if omitted.

data.description: String shorthand, single descriptor, or array of descriptors.

description.description: Short plain-text description shown as a native tooltip (HTML `title` attribute) when hovering the track label. No Markdown or HTML interpretation.

hidden.description: Ship this track hidden. The track is absent from the render but is listed as a stub in customize mode so a user can reveal it. This is the same field the show/hide control writes, so an author's choice and a user's are the same state and getConfig() exports whichever is current. Defaults to false.

detailOnly.description: Keep this track out of its group's collapsed (aggregate) view: it is ignored when the group's component is inferred and when the collapsed view's data is chosen. Use it on the detail half of a summary + detail pair. It does not change the track's own visibility, filter UI or expanded rendering, and has no effect on a standalone track. Defaults to false.

DataTooltip.description: Per-item tooltip. Three authoring forms: (a) a bare string — shorthand for a Markdoc template; (b) a fields object — declarative label/value rows; (c) a template object — explicit Markdoc template with optional extra variables. Rich, interactive, or stateful tooltips are not a config concern — listen for the Nightingale `change` event and mount your own UI, setting `notooltip` on the element to suppress the built-in popover.

TooltipFieldsSpec.description:
Declarative label/value rows. Each entry becomes `
label
` followed by the HTML-escaped value at `path`. Rich / interactive / stateful tooltips are not a config concern — consumers listen for the Nightingale `change` event, mount their own UI, and set `notooltip` on the element to suppress the built-in popover.

TooltipFieldSpec.description:
One row in a `fields`-form tooltip. `path` is a dotted property path against the item (e.g. `association.0.name`). The value at `path` is coerced to string, HTML-escaped, and wrapped in `

` at the leaf.

TooltipMarkdownSpec.description: Markdoc template rendered against the item's fields. `{% $field %}` interpolates scalars.

variables.description: Extra variables merged into the Markdoc scope alongside the item's fields. Useful for threading track-level context (accession, trackId) into per-item templates.

DataSourceDescriptor.description: Bridge between Intent and Representation. `from` defaults to "url".

format.description: How this source's bytes are encoded — not what the records mean, which the track's `kind` decides. Needed only when nothing can infer it: inline text, or a URL with no recognised extension. A file path like `./hits.csv` implies its format already.

ColorScaleConfig.description: Either a named theme OR explicit stops (at least one required). When both are present, explicit stops take precedence at render time.

SemanticKind.description: Open-string vocabulary. Closed-set validation (built-ins + runtime-registered kinds) is applied by the runtime validator, not this static schema.

ComponentName.description: Open-string vocabulary. Closed-set validation is applied by the runtime validator.

AdapterName.description: Open-string vocabulary. Closed-set validation is applied by the runtime validator.
